paragraphs.text:
An anguished cry warns you that Charlie has been hit. You 
glance over your shoulder, only to see her stagger a few more 
steps on stiff legs and then fall. Behind her, the creatures swarm.

To stop and help Charlie, go to 332. To race on with Bernard, go 
to 157.
